missing: Video missing or audio changed. Add the video again.
invalidSource: Enter a YouTube URL or 11-character ID.
youtubePlayer: YouTube video preview with original audio
waitingLyrics: No synced lyrics at this position.
permission: I can download and save this video
offsetHint: Use a positive value if the matching moment is later in the video.

offsetMatches: The saved offset matches the estimate.
offsetReview: Review the estimated offset before saving.

review.missing-reference: This video has no audio to compare. Choose an MP4 with audio, use a YouTube source, or set the offset manually.
review.reference-unavailable: The MV reference audio could not be retrieved. Change the source or set the offset manually.
review.insufficient-match: Too few matching points between the audio tracks. Choose an MV with the same recording or set the offset manually.
review.analysis-unavailable: Audio analysis did not finish. Change the source or set the offset manually.
review.duration-limit: This video exceeds the 10-minute analysis limit. Set the offset manually or change the source.
review.partial-match: Some sections matched. Review the timing before applying or change the source.
review.partial-offset: An estimated offset is filled in. Apply it and check audio and video from {start} to {end}, or change the source.

removeMessage: This frees the space used by the video. The song remains playable.

segmentPreview.failed: Could not play the segment. Try again.

waveform.title: Waveform comparison
waveform.empty: Run Auto sync to compare waveforms.
waveform.overview: Full song waveform. Click or drag to zoom into a section.
waveform.detail: Waveform comparison. Drag horizontally to adjust only the MV offset.

error.busy: Another video task is running. Try again shortly.
error.invalid-intent: Check the video ID, quality selection, or sync offset.
error.invalid-video: This video couldn't be verified. Choose a playable H.264 MP4.
error.no-formats: This source offers no compatible H.264 MP4 formats.
error.space: There is not enough disk space, or the video exceeds 2 GB.
error.stale: The audio or library has changed. Add the video again.
error.offset-stale: The video or audio has changed. Check the current video and try again.
error.unavailable: The video can't be opened or retrieved. Try again or choose a local file.
error.provider-disabled: Enable external sources in Settings first.
error.ffmpeg: Set up FFmpeg in Settings to verify the video.
